reportType: deployed Lighthouse desktop startup and full-wire gate

methodology.aggregation: Median (middle value after numeric ascending sort) of exactly three complete cold runs.
methodology.deployment: One immutable deployed HTTPS URL; local Vite preview and mutable local state are rejected.

profile.name: Lighthouse desktop, DevTools exact transport with no CPU slowdown

methodology.coldRun: A new Chrome user-data directory per run, browser cache/cookies cleared, cache disabled, and service workers bypassed.
methodology.skeletonMetric: PerformancePaintTiming first-contentful-paint startTime, accepted only when the nonzero visible loading skeleton state interval covers that timestamp.
methodology.readinessMetric: Trusted CDP sentinel input accepted by eager TinyMCE after an immediate current-state recheck, with both passive user accessibility and the product editor-ready mark required.
methodology.postMetricProofs: TinyMCE Ctrl+Z restoration plus trusted CodeMirror input and Ctrl+Z restoration are mandatory. They run after the sealed timing boundary; source-rich is forbidden before that boundary and required exactly once afterward.
methodology.wireMetric: Sum of Network.loadingFinished.encodedDataLength for every HTTP(S) request initiated through the canonical trusted-input boundary. This is full delivered wire, not local Brotli-11 recompression.
methodology.timerPolicy: Polling timeouts and network-idle observation can only fail or annotate a run. No delay, mark, selector, aria-busy value, or arbitrary timer can establish readiness by itself.

metricDefinitions.navigationToSkeletonPaintMs: Navigation start to FCP while the visible nonzero skeleton spans FCP.
metricDefinitions.skeletonPaintToEditorReadyMs: Skeleton FCP to trusted TinyMCE input acceptance, before rollback or CodeMirror diagnostics.
metricDefinitions.navigationToEditorReadyMs: Navigation start to trusted TinyMCE input acceptance; exact sum of the two preceding metrics.
metricDefinitions.canonicalFullWireBytes: Full wire bytes for canonical startup requests as reported by Network.loadingFinished.

readinessProof.definition: Canonical editorReadyAt is the trusted TinyMCE input event accepted after the current passive user-accessible state and product editor-ready mark are both present.

probeDiagnostics.note: readyOpportunityAt is a passive precursor. editorReadyAt is the subsequent trusted TinyMCE input event; readyOpportunityToVerifiedInputMs publishes the harness dispatch and reaction interval explicitly.

postMetricDiagnostics.definition: Undo integrity for TinyMCE and trusted CodeMirror input plus Ctrl+Z restoration are mandatory health proofs performed after the canonical timestamp. Focusing CodeMirror may load source-rich and cannot move editorReadyAt.

canonicalReadinessWindow.definition: Requests initiated from navigation through canonical trusted-input acceptance. Response facts are completed from the final session inventory.

postMetricDiagnostics.definition: Requests first initiated only after the canonical event boundary while completing undo and CodeMirror diagnostics.

runs.note: Standalone Lighthouse desktop gate evidence introduced by TZ 2.8 and inherited unchanged by TZ 2.9. No HAR is emitted and no canonical Network or local size report is read or changed. Canonical readiness is trusted TinyMCE input acceptance after the current UI passes the passive accessibility proof. Undo and CodeMirror checks remain mandatory post-metric diagnostics. Timeouts and transport-idle waits can only fail a run; they never establish product readiness.
